script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Jacob flees to Haran” describes events before Jacob reached Haran, not events at Haran. Its passage, Genesis 27:42–45, also does not include Jacob’s departure from Beersheba; that is in Genesis 28:10.
“Jacob meets Rachel” takes place at a well, but Genesis 29:4–10 does not say the well was in Haran. The shepherds say they are from Haran, which does not establish the well’s location.
“Abram leaves Haran” includes God’s call as though it happened at Haran. Genesis 12:1–3 does not locate the call there, and Acts 7:2–4 places God’s call before Abram lived in Haran.
